source.paper: McDonnell, Viner, Rivera, Xu, Smith 2020, 'Direct Observation of Intravalley Phonon Scattering of 2s Excitons in MoSe2 and WSe2 Monolayers', arXiv:2006.05912 (published 2D Mater. 2020); Viner, McDonnell, Ruiz-Tijerina, Rivera, Xu, Fal'ko, Smith 2021, 'Excited Rydberg States in TMD Heterostructures', 2D Mater. 8, 035047, arXiv:2103.09004
source.locator: McDonnell 2020: Fig. 4, p. 10 to 11, Table 1; Viner 2021: p. 3 to 4, SI S5, Table S3

items.text: The A1'/E' peak near 249 to 250 cm-1 is resonantly enhanced twice in the series, at the incoming (about 1.87 eV) and outgoing (about 1.90 eV) resonance with the A2s exciton
items.locator: McDonnell 2020 p. 5 (249.3 cm-1 single-phonon peak), Fig. 2d; Viner 2021 SI S5 (both resonances clearly visible with similar amplitude)

items.text: Places the A2s exciton at about 1.871 eV, i.e. about 130 meV above the A1s (1.740 eV)
items.locator: McDonnell 2020 Table 1 (A2s 1871 meV); Viner 2021 SI S5 (A1s-A2s 131 +/- 1 meV)

items.text: A peak near 495 cm-1 appears only around the A2s resonance: a single peak at the incoming resonance, vanishing just above it, then reappearing about 26 meV higher
items.locator: McDonnell 2020 p. 10 to 11 ('single Raman peak at 495.1 cm-1 at the incident resonance ... at first disappears ... returns ... threshold at about 26 meV'); Viner 2021 p. 3 to 4

items.text: The 495 cm-1 feature is dispersive: its frequency moves down (by a few cm-1) with increasing excitation energy, and near the outgoing resonance (about 1.93 eV) it grows strongly and splits into three peaks (about 492.7, 495.9, 499.9 cm-1)
items.locator: McDonnell 2020 Fig. 4 caption; Viner 2021 p. 4 ('disperses to lower shift by 2.5 cm-1 ... splits into three closely spaced peaks')

items.text: A dispersive peak cannot be a simple zone-centre phonon; it implies dark excitonic states with features (minima or saddle points) in their dispersion near the A2s energy
items.locator: McDonnell 2020 p. 11; Viner 2021 SI S5 (saddle point suggestion)

items.text: The spectra are parallel minus crossed; depolarized signals and luminescence are removed, so residual background or negative values are processing artifacts, not features
The peak assignment of the 495 cm-1 feature is open; the papers give no full explanation, so any specific phonon assignment is speculative
items.locator: McDonnell 2020 p. 11 ('no theoretical predictions ... available'); Viner 2021 SI S5

wrong_claims.text: Treats the 490 to 500 cm-1 feature as a fixed-frequency second-order overtone (2A1') without noting its dispersion
Attributes the 490 to 500 cm-1 feature to the Si substrate or hBN

notes: Nine spectra from the A2s sheet, about 1.843 to 1.956 eV. The A1s energy is given in the context because a researcher would know it from PL or reflectivity on the same sample; it is not in these spectra.
